set.body:
Epic: bd-01KXYJK0XSA3RNH9ANMVC96EPE

Migrate fit, design, group, AR, latent, MVPA, and related QR, Cholesky, inverse, and least-squares consumers to Gale.

Preserve Scalafim OlsSolvePolicy, rank and ridge policy, domain error mapping, multi-voxel matrix right-hand sides, normalized covariance, residualization, and explicit tolerances. Do not weaken rank-revealing behavior or replace QR with normal equations silently.

Acceptance
Focused JVM and JS suites pass; R-backed fit and statistical parity fixtures remain within declared tolerances; rank-deficient and ill-conditioned cases retain typed outcomes; response-block allocation and performance remain within recorded guardrails. Local generic factorization helpers are deleted as each consumer migrates.
set.title: Scalafim Gale migration 3: fit and factorization consumers
